stages.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Image1 is the animation contact sheet edit target, image2 is the approved 2bit style reference. Change ONLY the rendering style of ALL twelve sprites in image1 into the extremely coarse 2bit grayscale style of image2. Preserve EXACTLY the FOUR columns THREE rows grid, the twelve poses and their order, each sprite's scale, helmet height, center and cell. First two rows are eight distinct walking frames facing RIGHT, only feet moving; last row is standing idle, climbing UP back view, climbing DOWN back view, and vent crouch side view. Climbing characters must keep centered backpacks and NO front visor, hands near shoulders. All twelve images must use exactly four flat grayscale tones (black, dark gray, light gray, off-white), no red or cyan. Design each character as if it occupies only about12 by16 uniform square pixels, enlarged with nearest-neighbor, bold chunky stepped edges, recognizable Among Us crewmate bean anatomy, short legs, no walking arms. Simplify shading strongly; white/light gray body and dark-gray visor with white square glint. All12 cells need true transparent background and generous margins; entire sprite including hands and feet fits in its cell. No letters, numbers, labels, grid lines, scenery, floor, shadows, dithering, grain, gradients, smooth curves or antialiasing. No adding, removing, reordering or joining cells. 4:3 transparent contact sheet, twelve complete sprites total.

Use case: style-transfer. Image1 is the sprite contact sheet to edit, image2 is the approved 4bit style reference. Restyle ALL twelve sprites in image1 into image2's very simple low-color red crewmate artwork. Keep the exact 4 COLUMNS x3 ROWS grid, twelve poses, sprite centers, helmet heights, cell margins, facing directions and scale. The first eight cells form the right-facing walk loop; last row is idle, back-facing ladder climb UP, back-facing ladder climb DOWN, crouching vent pose. Do not add a front visor to the ladder sprites. Style: fewer/larger crisp square pixels than image1, as if each character is16pixels tall. Body is one FLAT bright red, outline deep navy, visor one flat cyan, one white square glint, only these4 flat colors, no shadow tone or gradient. Match the supplied 4bit character silhouette and proportions; no walking arms. Maintain distinct feet positions in all eight walk frames and different climbing hand positions. No whole-body bobbing between walking frames. Transparent alpha background, no drawn checkerboard, no numbers or labels or lines, no props, no floor/shadow, no glow, no textures, no blur, no antialiasing, no panels rearranged. All sprites fully inside their equal cells.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production animation SPRITE CONTACT SHEET for the red Among Us crewmate in reference image1, matching its chunky 8bit pixel art. Images2 and3 are POSITION/POSE REFERENCES ONLY for climbing up and down, not color references. Transparent alpha canvas with EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS and 3 ROWS of equally sized cells, 12 full-body sprites total, no labels or grid lines. Every sprite must fit wholly inside its own cell with generous empty transparent space around it, equal scale, aligned stationary helmet centers and common ground height, NO overall body bounce. Row1 columns1-4 and row2 columns1-4: eight sequential walking-cycle frames facing RIGHT in three-quarter side view; same helmet, visor and backpack, only feet alternate swinging/lifting forward and back, moving two short legs through an actual smooth eight-frame loop; no arms on walking/idle sprites. Row3 column1: standing idle facing right, exactly matching reference1's normal anatomy. Row3 column2: climbing UP seen from BACK, backpack centered, no visible front visor, right gloved hand up, left hand down, feet offset as if climbing. Row3 column3: climbing DOWN seen from BACK, left gloved hand up, right hand down, opposite feet. Hands must stay attached close to shoulders and well within their cell; NO detached floating hands outside the cell. Row3 column4: crouching for entering/exiting a vent, side view facing right with bent legs. No ladder, no vent object, no scenery. Style: consistently large crisp square pixels like 32x32 game sprites enlarged with nearest-neighbor, uniform pixel grid, dark navy outline, red suit with one dark-red shadow, cyan glass visor and a tiny white square reflection, about7 flat colors, no smooth curves or antialiasing. Maintain the exact usual Among Us bean crewmate anatomy and distinctive backpack throughout. No hats, costumes, accessories, humanoid limbs, faces, ears. No text, digits, borders, grid, floor, shadow, glow, textures, dithering, blur, gradients, decorative particles. True transparent background between and around sprites, not a baked checkerboard. A wide 4:3 contact sheet with twelve equally spaced square cells. Most important: full distinct eight walking frames and clearly back-facing up/down climbing frames, all twelve cells correctly aligned.
